annotations.title: Answer a question from a dataset

description: Ask a database in plain English (text to SQL): any BigQuery table, including Google's public datasets. The SQL is written for you, run under a byte ceiling, and the rows are read back into a written answer, returned with the SQL, columns and rows it used. Use it for analytics questions without writing SQL. Input: question, table; optional columns. $5.00 per call. Returns: answer, sql, columns[], rows[], gib_processed.

language.description: Optional answer language, BCP-47 (en, ja, pt-BR). Default: the input's.
